script:
for row in (doc.time_logs or []):

    if not row.custom_ticket or not row.hours:
        continue

    # 🔥 Get HD Ticket
    ticket = frappe.get_doc("HD Ticket", row.custom_ticket)

    # 🔥 Remove old entries for this timesheet
    ticket.set("custom_hours_usage", [
        d for d in (ticket.custom_hours_usage or [])
        if d.timesheet != doc.name
    ])

    # 🔥 Add new entry
    ticket.append("custom_hours_usage", {
        "date": row.from_time,
        "employee": doc.employee,
        "hours": row.hours,
        "timesheet": doc.name
    })

    # 🔥 Calculate totals
    total = sum(d.hours or 0 for d in (ticket.custom_hours_usage or []))

    ticket.custom_logged_hours = total
    ticket.custom_remaining_hour = (ticket.estimated_hours or 0) - total

    ticket.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    ticket.save()

Skipping year-end notification.") else: fiscal_year_end = frappe.utils.getdate(fiscal_year.year_end_date) days_remaining = (fiscal_year_end - today_date).days if days_remaining == 7: # Resolve display names (BS / Nepali calendar if available) bs_fy_doc = frappe.get_doc("Fiscal Year", fiscal_year.name) nepali_start = getattr(bs_fy_doc, "nepali_year_start_date", None) nepali_end = getattr(bs_fy_doc, "nepali_year_end_date", None) if nepali_start and nepali_end: bs_start = str(nepali_start)[:4] bs_end = str(nepali_end)[:4] current_fy = f"{bs_start}-{bs_end}" next_fy = f"{bs_end}-{int(bs_end) + 1}" else: parts = fiscal_year.name.split("-") current_fy = fiscal_year.name next_fy = "-".join(str(int(p) + 1) for p in parts) subject = ( f"Action Required: Fiscal Year {current_fy} ending in {days_remaining} day(s)" ) message = f"""

Verify slab rates match IRD Nepal Finance Act for {next_fy}.

Days remaining: {days_remaining} day(s) until {fiscal_year_end}

Regards,
Frappe HR System

""" # Collect recipients with CEO role (exclude Administrator) ceo_users = frappe.get_all( "Has Role", filters={"role": "CEO", "parenttype": "User"}, fields=["parent"], ) recipients = list(set( u["parent"] for u in ceo_users if u["parent"] != "Administrator" )) # Fall back to system email address if no CEO user found if not recipients: fallback = frappe.db.get_single_value("System Settings", "email_footer_address") if fallback: recipients = [fallback] if recipients: frappe.sendmail( recipients=recipients, subject=subject, message=message, now=True, ) frappe.logger().info( f"FY reminder sent: {days_remaining} days before {fiscal_year_end}" ) else: frappe.logger().warning("No recipients found. def create_folder(name, parent):
    existing = frappe.db.exists("File", {
        "file_name": name,
        "is_folder": 1,
        "folder": parent
    })

    if existing:
        return existing

    folder = frappe.new_doc("File")
    folder.file_name = name
    folder.is_folder = 1
    folder.folder = parent
    folder.is_private = 0

    folder.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    folder.flags.ignore_links = True
    folder.flags.ignore_mandatory = True

    folder.db_insert()

    return folder.name

name: Update Timesheet
script:
if not frappe.flags.get("amc_sync_running"):

    frappe.flags.amc_sync_running = True

    if doc.custom_amc_contract:

        amc = frappe.get_doc("AMC Contract", doc.custom_amc_contract)

        # SAFETY: ensure child table exists
        if not amc.get("table_bxbb"):
            amc.table_bxbb = []

        # REMOVE OLD ENTRIES FOR THIS TIMESHEET
        amc.table_bxbb = [
            d for d in (amc.table_bxbb or [])
            if d.timesheet != doc.name
        ]

        # ADD NEW ENTRIES
        for row in (doc.time_logs or []):

            if not row.hours:
                continue

            amc.append("table_bxbb", {
                "date": row.from_time,
                "hours_usage": row.hours,
                "employee": doc.employee,
                "timesheet": doc.name,
                "activity_type": row.activity_type,
                "ticket": row.custom_ticket
            })

        # CALCULATE TOTAL USED HOURS
        total_used = sum(
            (d.hours_usage or 0)
            for d in (amc.table_bxbb or [])
        )

        amc.hours_used = total_used

        # TOTAL HOURS
        total_hours = amc.total_hours or 0

        # REMAINING HOURS
        remaining = total_hours - total_used

        amc.hours_remaining = (
            remaining if remaining > 0 else 0
        )

        # LOW BALANCE ALERT
        if total_hours > 0:

            percent_remaining = (
                (amc.hours_remaining / total_hours) * 100
            )

            if percent_remaining <= 20:

                frappe.msgprint(
                    f"⚠ AMC Low Balance! Remaining: "
                    f"{amc.hours_remaining} hrs "
                    f"({percent_remaining:.1f}%)"
                )

                amc.add_comment(
                    "Comment",
                    f"Low Balance Alert: "
                    f"{amc.hours_remaining} hrs remaining "
                    f"({percent_remaining:.1f}%)"
                )

        # SAVE FLAGS
        amc.flags.ignore_validate_update_after_submit = True
        amc.flags.ignore_mandatory = True
        amc.flags.ignore_permissions = True

        amc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
